milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the bamboo grove (centered at spawn-relative -6, 1, -4) and face it, confirming visual identification. Max distance 8 allows the player to see the bamboo from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance 60 ensures they are looking toward it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because mining leaves means breaking block(s) from the tree. The acacia leaves are placed in a region from (3,3,-6) to (7,5,-2) spawn-relative, totaling 58 blocks. Setting max_count=57 requires at least 1 leaf to be broken. This directly checks that the player has mined (destroyed) at least one acacia_leaves block.

Uses inventory_has because smelting sand in the furnace produces glass that ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 glass (only sand and coal), so having at least 1 glass confirms successful smelting. This is preferred over craft_item event tracking since furnace smelting may not trigger the craft counter reliably.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cake is placed at spawn-relative (0, 1, 10) on a stone brick pedestal behind the furnace area. Max distance 8 allows the player to see the cake from a reasonable approach distance, and facing_tolerance 60 ensures they are looking toward it, confirming visual identification.
